notes:
The page gives a three-generator presentation using rho, sigma_0, tau_0, rewrites a relation in commutator form, and expresses the resulting group as a quotient of a free product. It then observes a symmetry exchanging sigma_0 and tau_0 and inverting rho, while saying that this symmetry is incompatible with the extension structure because of what happens in the indicated quotient and its centre. The marginal int(rho)sigma_0 starter is canceled in favor of the commutator equality. The ink has heterogeneous labels i) and b), and these are not regularized. An extra live de followed by a canceled starter precedes the next-line de suite; the restart is retained. En en is also retained. No independent algebraic proof check or outside background was used. The brace attachment was decided visually, not from H's mathematical explanation of which factors ought to be grouped.
Independent audit: the multiplication point after rho squared is distinct dark ink and is now unqualified. The state of the right-margin i.e. remains uncertain (canceled or live), and a colon/semicolon-like pair of dark points is preserved between the two en words. No additional algebraic proof was performed.

Dotted i and looped e survive, but the thick connecting baseline may be a cancellation or an extended join. Keep cancellation first and explicitly admit the live abbreviation.
